title: Bullhorn Cyber Incident developing now.
description: Bullhorn, a provider of ATS/CRM and related recruitment software platforms, is currently experiencing a cyber incident causing a system-wide outage and service disruption. Access to Bullhorn systems has been temporarily disabled to contain the incident while investigations are ongoing with the assistance of cybersecurity specialists. The disruption affects multiple Bullhorn services globally, requiring non-SSO users to reset passwords upon login once services are restored. The incident is actively being investigated, and updates are being posted on Bullhorn's official status page.

references.title: Reddit Discussion: Bullhorn Cyber Incident developing now.

aiSummary: Bullhorn is undergoing a cyber incident resulting in a major outage across its ATS/CRM and associated platforms worldwide. The company has temporarily disabled access to its systems to contain the incident and is working with Crowdstrike cybersecurity specialists to investigate and resolve the issue. The outage impacts multiple Bullhorn services including ATS/CRM clusters, automation modules, Talent Platform, Back Office, and others across regions such as Australia, UK, EMEA, and the US. Non-SSO users will be required to reset passwords upon service restoration. The incident is ongoing with no confirmed details on the nature of the attack or data compromise. Bullhorn is providing continuous updates via its status website.
aiImpact: The incident has caused a system-wide outage affecting Bullhorn's ATS/CRM and related services globally, leading to temporary loss of access for users. Key functionalities such as placement syncing, time entry, and approval processes are disrupted, particularly for customers using integrated Bullhorn Time & Expense solutions. The outage impacts multiple service clusters and regions, causing operational disruption for Bullhorn customers. There is no public confirmation of data breach or exploitation details at this time.
